issues.title: Workaround for `flatpickr`
issues.body:
While the `flatpickr` control works in json-editor on the json-editor repo, it doesn't work properly in Serge.

In particular, the options don't appear to get passed to it, meaning:
- it doesn't include the time edit controls
- we can provide any of the other `flatpickr` functions, such as only offering particular dates/times.

We need a workaround.  I propose this.  We introduce a new `customise template` method, which receives the current game time and turn length.  If the turn length is under one weeks, provide a drop-down menu of 2-hour time steps, otherwise provide a drop-down menu of whole-day steps.
